That single shift wouldn't magically create utopia—scarcity, trade-offs, and genuine value disagreements would remain—but it would remove one of the biggest self-imposed brakes on progress. Everything else (energy abundance, healthspan, governance quality, reduced violence) becomes more solvable once reality is allowed to win arguments more often.
